our_purpose_description: Our dream is not only to share style, but comfort with those who feel the power of the hooodie. Our concept is based on one rule: quality over quantity. You’ve seen all the colours, felt all the materials. What we offer is simple. The simplest, yet most desirable design: our hooodie.
how_it_started_description: We always wanted to give people quality products, set trends, provide style. We started as a small team – a few friends – who wanted to make a difference. We gathered the best materials we had always wanted to wear and started making our dreams a reality. It was a passion project. With this passion, we decided to share it – and our other ideas – with the world, with YOU!
our_materials_description: Quality is the most important ingredient of a perfect hoodie. We don’t believe in outsourcing production. We wanted to make it – and now we finally can. We hope you feel it too.
work_with_us_description: We are constantly growing. We want to share our joy and passion with you! Our first store is in Szeged, and we plan to expand. Whether by phone, email, or in person – feel free to reach out! We’d be honoured to have you join us!

cotton_100: This hoodie is crafted from 100% pure cotton, providing you with ultimate breathability, softness, and natural comfort all day long.
cotton_80_polyester_20: Made from a blend of 80% cotton and 20% polyester, this hoodie combines natural softness with enhanced durability and wrinkle resistance.
cotton_70_polyester_30: Featuring a blend of 70% cotton and 30% polyester, this hoodie offers excellent comfort, easy care, and lasting shape retention for your everyday wear.
